hook_line: FAIRFAX TO TAKE CONTROL OF IDBI BANK

hook_stat.sub: Stake in IDBI Bank the Cabinet has approved Fairfax to acquire

stats.label: Value of Fairfax's bid for the controlling stake in IDBI Bank
Government stake being sold in IDBI Bank
LIC stake being sold in IDBI Bank

diaspora_bullets: The government says the deal will be the largest FDI ever in India's financial sector
The government and LIC will retain a combined 34% in the bank
news_summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved Fairfax Financial Holdings as strategic buyer of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank.
payoff: Cabinet approval is not completion — Fairfax must present its credentials to the RBI under the fit-and-proper assessment.
